figures.name: Mawu

ability.name: Moon Wisdom
ability.description: All allies gain +2 wisdom; remove all confusion effects from allies.

figures.description: Female creator moon deity and the wisdom half of the creator twin pair who governs night and intellect.

figures.name: Lisa

ability.name: Solar Strength
ability.description: All allies gain +3 power from the sun's strength for 1 turn.

figures.description: Male creator sun deity and the strength half of the creator twin pair who governs day and power.

figures.name: Legba

ability.name: Crossroads Key
ability.description: Unlock one sealed enemy ability and use it against them; open all closed gates on the field.

figures.description: Trickster divine old man at the crossroads between worlds, the first to be honored in every ceremony.

figures.name: Ogou

ability.name: Iron Revolution
ability.description: Destroy all armor and shield effects; deal 4 damage to all enemies from the revolutionary iron.

figures.description: Warrior god of iron and fire who governs war, revolution and the fighting spirit of the oppressed.

figures.name: Sakpata

ability.name: Earth Judgment
ability.description: Inflict disease on one enemy: -2 HP per turn for 3 turns; grant allies immunity to earth disease.

figures.description: Lord of the earth and smallpox who strikes down wrongdoers with disease but heals those who show respect.

figures.name: Mami Wata

ability.name: Mami's Mirror
ability.description: Charm one enemy; they fight for your side for 1 turn while gazing at her reflection.

figures.description: Beautiful water spirit half-human half-fish who brings wealth or madness to those who encounter her.

figures.name: Gu

ability.name: Divine Cutlass
ability.description: This card's next attack cannot be blocked or deflected by any means.

figures.description: The divine cutlass of the gods — Gu — the force of iron and all tools that enables civilized life.

figures.name: Xevioso

ability.name: Thunder Justice
ability.description: Strike one evil-aligned enemy for 7 damage; all storm allies gain +2 power.

figures.description: Thunder deity of the Ewe who executes divine justice through lightning and controls the rains.

figures.name: Agbe

ability.name: Ocean Abundance
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all water and sea allies; deal 2 damage to all land-only enemies.

figures.description: God of the deep blue sea and all ocean abundance, husband of Naete the sea goddess.

figures.name: Dan

ability.name: Rainbow Arc
ability.description: Move any card to any position; remove all paralysis and stun effects from allies.

figures.description: The great rainbow serpent who coils around the world and whose movement enables all things to change.

figures.name: Nana Buluku (Fon)

ability.name: Ancient Will
ability.description: Your next ability bypasses all enemy counters and immunities.

figures.description: The most ancient creator, grandmother to the gods, who created Mawu-Lisa and stands above all Vodun.

figures.name: Nesuhwe

ability.name: Royal Ancestor
ability.description: All Dahomey/Fon allies gain +2 to all stats from royal ancestral power.

figures.description: The royal ancestral spirits of the Dahomey kingdom who continue to govern through the divine authority of the dead.

figures.name: Agassu

ability.name: Leopard Blood
ability.description: Grant one ally the predator trait: they can attack twice in one turn once per battle.

figures.description: The leopard ancestor and progenitor of the Dahomey royal lineage whose spotted power flows in royal blood.

figures.name: Fa

ability.name: Destiny Reading
ability.description: Look at the enemy's full plan for 2 turns and choose one to nullify.

figures.description: The divine system of fate and divination (equivalent to Yoruba Ifa) that reveals each person's destiny.

figures.name: Tovodun

ability.name: Clan Shield
ability.description: All members of the same type as this card gain +2 defense from clan protection.

figures.description: The clan Vodun who protects specific family lineages and demands specific offerings in return.

figures.name: Azonsu

ability.name: Forest Track
ability.description: This card can target any enemy regardless of row or position.

figures.description: The hunter Vodun of the forest who grants tracking skills and forest knowledge to Fon hunters.

figures.name: Minona

ability.name: First Woman
ability.description: All female/goddess allies gain +2 to all stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: The divine spirit of women and feminine power who was present at the very first divination.

figures.name: Aido Hwedo

ability.name: World Coils
ability.description: When this card takes damage, transfer 2 of that damage to any enemy instead.

figures.description: The great serpent that carried the creator in its mouth during creation and now coils beneath the earth bearing it.

figures.name: Heviosso

ability.name: Thunder Axe
ability.description: Deal 5 lightning damage to one enemy; remove all their buffs from divine retribution.

figures.description: The Fon thunder Vodun who hurls his double-headed axe as lightning at wrongdoers.

figures.name: Djoto

ability.name: Fertile Ground
ability.description: All earth and nature effects on the field restore 1 additional HP to allies this turn.

figures.description: The earth spirit who governs the sacred soil, demanding proper agricultural rituals for fertile harvests.
